pricing.faq.title: Frequently asked questions
pricing.faq.subtitle: Real questions people send us, answered honestly.
pricing.faq.gpl.q: What is GPLv3 and how does it affect me?
pricing.faq.gpl.a: TypeWhisper is open source under GPLv3. You may install and run the GPL version as-is, including for internal professional or commercial work, subject to the GPL. Premium features such as Cloud Folder Sync and Automatic Correction Learning require a Commercial license. If you distribute, embed, rebrand, or ship TypeWhisper in a way that is not GPL-compatible, or if you need procurement, invoicing, or priority support, use a Commercial license.
pricing.faq.freelancer.q: I'm a freelancer - do I need a commercial license?
pricing.faq.freelancer.a: Not merely because you run the unmodified GPL app while working. Consider the Individual tier if you want Premium sync or automatic correction learning, or if you need non-GPL terms, invoicing, procurement, priority support, or rights to redistribute/ship TypeWhisper in a proprietary context.
pricing.faq.workPay.q: I use it at work but pay for it myself - what tier?
pricing.faq.workPay.a: For ordinary internal use of the unmodified GPL app, you can stay on the GPL path. Use a Commercial tier if you want Premium sync or automatic correction learning, or if your employer needs non-GPL terms, procurement, invoicing, support, or managed licensing.
pricing.faq.upgrade.q: Can I upgrade from Individual to Team later?
pricing.faq.upgrade.a: Yes. Write to hello@typewhisper.com and we'll prorate the difference against your existing subscription or lifetime purchase.
pricing.faq.supporterVsCommercial.q: What's the difference between a Supporter tier and a Commercial license?
pricing.faq.supporterVsCommercial.a: Supporter tiers are a thank-you for individuals who want to fund the project. They do not grant alternative commercial license terms. If you need non-GPL terms, procurement, support, or proprietary redistribution/embedding rights, use a Commercial license.
pricing.faq.lifetimeUpdates.a: Yes. Lifetime covers all future TypeWhisper updates in the same product line.
pricing.faq.cancel.q: What happens if I cancel my monthly subscription?
pricing.faq.cancel.a: You keep commercial-license benefits until the end of your paid period. After that, the commercial license expires; you can still use the app under GPLv3, but non-GPL terms, procurement/support benefits, and managed commercial rights would require renewal.
pricing.faq.refund.a: Yes. Write to hello@typewhisper.com within 14 days of purchase and we'll refund you, no questions asked.
pricing.faq.discounts.q: Do you offer educational or non-profit discounts?
pricing.faq.discounts.a: Non-profits and students, get in touch at hello@typewhisper.com. We usually have headroom for fair discounts.
pricing.faq.activate.q: How do I activate my license?
pricing.faq.activate.a: Open TypeWhisper, go to Settings > License > 'Already have a key?', paste the key you received after checkout, and it activates on the current device.
